svg.title: Dual Slope — proposed panel layout
svg.desc: Two identical slope-generator channels with four triple-knAck controls each, mode and cycle selectors, trigger/signal/reset/pitch inputs, out and end outputs, and a global strip with link selector, reset, run, and combined mix/max/diff/or outputs.
svg.text: Outer ring — CV depth / attenuverter (scroll; centre = zero)
Centre hole — CV input jack (click to patch a cable)
